name: Qwen Image 2.1 — text to image
description:
Make an image from a written description with Qwen Image 2.1. It is unusually good at TEXT inside the picture — signs, posters, packaging, handwriting — in Latin and Chinese alike, so put the words you want rendered in quotes and say where they sit.

Size: the default 1 megapixel is 1024×1024. This model is trained for 2K, so for a big print set the size to 4 megapixels (2048×2048 at 1:1). Pick the aspect ratio first; the width and height follow.

Transparent PNG: wrap your prompt exactly like this and the model returns a cut-out with a real alpha channel —
"This is an RGBA format image with transparency. <your subject>. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background."

Steps: 25 is a quick pass. Qwen's own pipeline uses 40–50, which is worth it for detailed scenes and for clean lettering. There is no negative prompt: guidance is fixed at 1, which is how this model is meant to run.

promptGuides.label: Qwen-Image-2.1 — official model card
promptGuides.tip: Describe the scene in full sentences and put any words to be rendered in "quotes", saying where they appear. For a transparent PNG, use the RGBA wording in the description above — it is the phrasing Qwen documents.

promptGuides.label: Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1 — the models this bundle runs
